items.exampleEn: The team is warming up on the field.
Mr. Lin flew to Tokyo to attend a meeting.
items.exampleZh: 林先生飛到東京出席一場會議。

items.exampleEn: It took the team a week to come to a conclusion.
items.exampleZh: 團隊花了一週才得出結論。

items.exampleEn: Without new customers, the shop could go bankrupt.
items.exampleZh: 沒有新客人的話，這家店可能會破產。

items.exampleEn: Our club holds a meeting on the first Friday of every month.
items.exampleZh: 我們社團每個月第一個星期五開會。

items.exampleEn: Please call and make an appointment first.
One guest made a complaint about the cold room.
items.exampleZh: 一位房客投訴房間太冷。

items.sentenceEn: Can you warm the soup up for me?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以幫我把湯加熱嗎？

items.audioEn: The bookstore next to our office went bankrupt, so now we have to buy books online.
items.audioZh: 我們辦公室旁邊的書店破產了，所以現在我們只能在網路上買書。
options: At a big bookstore in another city

items.sentenceEn: The runners warmed up before the race.
items.sentenceZh: 跑者們在比賽前做了熱身。

items.sentenceEn: Have you come to a conclusion yet?

items.stemEn: I need to ____ with the bank manager for next week.
items.stemZh: 我需要預約下週和銀行經理見面。

items.stemEn: The manager decided to ____ to discuss the new plan.
items.stemZh: 經理決定開會討論新計畫。

items.passageEn: Last year, a small travel company in our city almost went bankrupt. The owner held a meeting with all the staff to talk about the problem. Everyone shared ideas, and after three hours they decided that the company would focus on tours for families instead of business travelers. The owner also attended a meeting with the city's tourism office to ask for advice. Today, the company is busier than ever.
items.passageZh: 去年，我們市裡一家小旅行社差點破產。老闆和全體員工開會討論這個問題。大家都提出了想法，三個小時後，他們決定公司要把重點放在家庭旅遊行程，而不是商務旅客。老闆也去市政府觀光局開會，請他們提供建議。現在，這家公司比以往都還要忙。

questions.questionZh: 公司後來決定把重點放在哪裡？
options: 和市政府合作的觀光活動

questions.questionZh: 老闆為什麼去觀光局開會？

items.promptZh: 我明天下午會去出席一個會議。
referenceEn: I will attend a meeting tomorrow afternoon.
Tomorrow afternoon, I'm going to attend a meeting.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「出席會議」（例如 attend a meeting 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 go to a meeting、have a meeting 等）
有「明天下午」，用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、am going to 等）；寫現在進行式 am attending 也正確

items.promptZh: 我的鄰居向房東投訴我們太吵。
referenceEn: My neighbor made a complaint to the landlord about our noise.
My neighbor made a complaint to the landlord that we were too noisy.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「投訴」（例如 made a complaint to the landlord 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 complained to the landlord 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 made、has made 等）
「我們太吵」可寫，例如 about our noise、that we were too noisy 等
